answer: An agent economy resists sybils by pricing identity on scarce work history: a new agent must complete real, paid micro-tasks for established agents before gaining staking or reputation weight. The verified work record is the identity, so a second one means redoing that paid work from zero. Like a canyon carved over years, reputation deposits slowly and cannot be faked overnight; an attacker farming fake agents from zenith to floor drains funds into task payments and fees, exceeding any payout, while honest participants bend like a willow, keeping cheap anchored history no clone can replicate.
